info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Balancing Services Adjustment - Net API
Net balancing services adjustment time series (NETBSAD)

params.name: from
params.description: The "from" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: to
params.description: The "to" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: includeZero
params.description: Include data points with a generation of zero.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides data about the Net Balancing Services Adjustment (NETBSAD). Each
entry in the time series contains the NETBSAD values for that settlement period.
            
By default, the from and to parameters filter the data by time inclusively. If the settlementPeriodFrom or
settlementPeriodTo parameters are provided, the corresponding from or to parameter instead filters on settlement
date, allowing for searching by a combination of time and/or settlement date & settlement period.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of events to return.

params.name: before
params.description:
If specified, filters events to those with a start time before or at the date, or a settlement date before the date if
settlementPeriodBefore is also specified.
If omitted, latest events are returned.

params.name: settlementPeriodBefore
params.description:
Filters events to those with a settlement period before or at the value.
Before parameter must be specified if this is specified.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides data about the start of NGESO Net Balancing Services Adjustment (NETBSAD) events.
An event is a point in time where one of the NETBSAD values has changed from 0 to a value.
Each event details the start time of the event and the NETBSAD values associated with the start of the event.
